source.section: Software Optimization Guide for AMD Family 19h Processors (Pub 56665 Rev 3.00), sections 2.10.1-2.10.2
source.quote:
The processor contains 4 general purpose integer execution pipes. Each pipe has an ALU capable of general purpose integer operations.
ALU1 additionally has multiply/CRC/PDEP/PEXT capability and ALU0 additionally has divide and branch execution capability.
There is also a separate branch execution unit (BRU) attached to scheduler 3. There are three Address Generation Units (AGUs) for
all load and store address generation.
source.note: Official page docs.amd.com/v/u/en-US/56665 is JavaScript-only; quote from third-party mirror.

source.section: Cortex-A55 Software Optimization Guide (ARM-EPM-128372), chapter 3 Pipeline
source.quote:
The Arithmetic and Logical Unit (ALU) pipeline can forward results from the end of ex1 and ex2 to earlier stages of both ALU
The DIV pipeline can only accept operands in the iss stage
The MAC pipeline can only accept multiply operands in the iss stage
The first stage (ex1) of both the load and store pipeline contains an AGU.
source.note: A55 is in-order; pipes are ALU x2, MAC, DIV, load, store, FPALU, FPMAC, FPDIV, branch.
